title: Rain on Kaburo
caption: Slow film noir jazz ballad, instrumental. Smoky tenor saxophone lead with a breathy tone, soft brushed drums, warm upright double bass, sparse late-night piano chords, the natural reverb of a small empty club. Melancholy, intimate, a rainy city at two in the morning. Recorded live, warm vintage analog sound. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration B).
